about: Reads a student's own OpenBao namespace `students/<user>` (the namespace is always derived from the checking student, never an argument) with a read-only checker token: BAO_URL (http://openbao:8200) and BAO_CHECK_TOKEN. Reads only, and never a secret value: policy text, role settings, KV metadata and lease id lists. The checker token's policy, written in the root namespace, needs only: read on `students/+/sys/policies/acl/*`, `students/+/auth/+/role/*`, `students/+/database/roles/*`, `students/+/+/metadata/*`; list on `students/+/sys/leases/lookup/database/creds/*`. It must NOT read `+/data/*`, `database/creds/*` or `sys/mounts`. No root token is ever used. Every verb takes `student` (put `{user}` there in a catalog): the check is refused unless it is the student being checked.

policy_grants.does: the ACL policy exists and grants read on every path in allow, and not on any path in deny (an explicit deny counts; `*` and `+` in the policy's paths are honoured); only: every path the policy names starts with one of these prefixes

role_policy_grants.does: the role auth/<mount>/role/<role> exists, has at least one policy other than `default`, and those policies together grant read on every allow path and not on any deny path

auth_role.does: auth/<mount>/role/<role> exists and its token_policies include every one of policies

db_role.does: database/roles/<role> exists with exactly this default_ttl and max_ttl (seconds, or 2m, 10m, 1h)

lease_exists.does: at least one live lease under sys/leases/lookup/<prefix> (for example database/creds/c2-app); lease ids only, never the credential

kv_version.does: the KV v2 secret <mount>/<path> has current_version >= min_version (metadata only, never the value)
